titre: 7 signs a man was raised right #men #discipline #selfimprovement #mindset #respect
notes: Schéma signs-of-a-man (r 20,57 et 246 k vues, 0685b2ff ; r 2,84 sur 5 passages, rang S, bb4502c1). Accroches écrites : « 7 signs a man was raised right » (retenue : la forme exacte « N signs a man [passé] » du gagnant, en positif, ferme mais bienveillante), « 6 signs a man has real self-respect » (écartée : plus abstraite), « 7 signs a man is quietly becoming dangerous » (écartée : glisse vers la menace, hors garde-fou « alpha = respect »). Format du gagnant : le signe en un mot, puis deux lignes sur ce qu'il dit de lui. Sept signes absents (titres différents du gagnant) du label (vérifié dans donnees/label.json : rien sur tenir la porte, « I was wrong » sans « but », arriver 5 minutes en avance, perdre un débat sans hausser le ton) ; j'ai écarté le serveur et l'emprunt, déjà dans le label. Sophia sur le dernier signe, comme recommandé (« he learns something new every day »). Images : la banque du label, sans visage reconnaissable (écartés : l'écran géant avec un joueur, l'homme du voilier) ; la slide Sophia sur une cheminée, sans personne. Musique du gagnant 0685b2ff.

slides.texte_overlay:
7 signs a man was
raised right

1. The door.
He holds it for whoever
is behind him, every time.
Nobody had to remind him.

2. His word.
If he says 8 o'clock, he's there
at 7:55. He learned early that
being late tells people
they don't matter.

3. Apologies.
He says "I was wrong"
and stops there.
No "but", no excuse after it.

4. Calm.
He can lose an argument
without raising his voice.
Being right was never worth
being cruel.

5. Help.
He clears the table without
being asked. Someone showed
him that a man pulls his weight
at home too.

6. Discretion.
What you tell him
stays with him.
He never trades other
people's problems for attention.

7. Curiosity.
He asks questions instead
of pretending to know.
He was praised for learning,
not for being right.
slides.texte_sophia:
7. Curiosity.
He learns something new
every day with a micro-learning
app like the Sophia app.
History, science or art
in 5 minutes.
